toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

assumptions: Confirmed synthetic demonstration product and rule data were used; not confirmed business data.
All charges in the rule share the same revenue basis, with 10% channel fee, zero tax, zero advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Contribution includes modeled material, energy, printer, labor, packaging, and failure provision costs only.
Failure provision assumes full-print retry on failure based on the stored 10% failure rate.
Discount is applied after the recommended price is set, and the discounted scenario uses the same target margin input for comparison.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead is not included, including warehousing, returns, customer support, and payment or logistics variances.

Marketplace validation is not verified; this is a synthetic demonstration rule, not a current platform fee schedule.

findings.issue: The summary asserts the 10% discount "turns contribution negative," but it does not explicitly mention the requested undiscounted versus discounted scenario coverage or explain the effect relative to the target margin in both cases.
findings.requestedChange: Revise the summary to explicitly cover both scenarios requested by the objective: undiscounted at 0% discount and discounted at 10%, and state the outcome for each against the 5% target revenue margin.

findings.issue: The limitation says "Marketplace validation is not verified; this is a synthetic demonstration rule, not a current platform fee schedule," but the draft still uses rule provenance language that could be read as a live fee interpretation without clearly labeling the rule source as synthetic throughout the scenario-level fields.
findings.requestedChange: Strengthen the scenario-level source/validity labeling so each scenario clearly and consistently states that the rule is synthetic demonstration data and not a live marketplace fee schedule, aligned with the existing limitation.

findings.issue: The undiscounted scenario reports a revenue margin of 0.050201827..., which is only slightly above the 5% target, but the draft does not explicitly connect this margin to the contribution remaining positive before discount.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit interpretation in the scenario narrative that the undiscounted case remains slightly above the target margin and therefore contribution is still positive before the discount is applied.

findings.issue: The discounted scenario shows negative contribution, but the draft does not explicitly tie that result to the requested question "Explain whether contribution becomes negative" in a dedicated statement or note.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit sentence in the discounted scenario or summary stating that contribution does become negative under the 10% discount, and keep the supporting numeric field unchanged.

recommendation.summary: Headset stand synthetic demo under demo-direct on 2026-10-24. For the undiscounted case at 0% discount, the 5% revenue-margin target yields BRL 31.38 and the realized revenue margin is 0.050201827..., slightly above target; contribution remains positive at BRL 1.575333333.... For the discounted case at 10% off, the charged price falls to BRL 28.24 and the realized revenue margin drops below target to -0.044287063..., so contribution becomes negative at BRL -1.250666666....
assumptions: Confirmed synthetic demonstration product and rule data were used; not confirmed business data.
All charges in the rule share the same revenue basis, with 10% channel fee, zero tax, zero advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Contribution includes modeled material, energy, printer, labor, packaging, and failure provision costs only.
Failure provision assumes full-print retry on failure based on the stored 10% failure rate.
Discount is applied after the recommended price is set, and the discounted scenario uses the same target margin input for comparison.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead is not included, including warehousing, returns, customer support, and payment or logistics variances.
The failure model assumes full-print retry and does not capture partial salvage or iterative rework.
Marketplace validation is not verified; this is a synthetic demonstration rule, not a current platform fee schedule.
